title: containerd image manifest processing can crash the daemon
summary: Malformed digests in subject-annotated descriptors cause an unrecovered panic during transfer-service pulls or imports. Repeated Kubernetes image-pull retries can repeatedly crash the daemon.

severity.rationale: A crafted image can disrupt container operations, but the documented impact is denial of service. Developer and CI image pulls can reach this path.

exposure: The affected transfer-service path includes default CRI PullImage requests. An attacker must get an untrusted image pulled or imported.

params.instructions: Check containerd version and whether the documented exposure conditions apply.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade to containerd 2.2.10, 2.3.7 or 2.4.2 on the corresponding line. Until then, restrict image sources to trusted registries.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updates can interrupt workflows and require compatibility checks.

verification: Confirm the deployed component uses the patched release and test the affected workflow with harmless inputs.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
